description: Android Fragment class 'PhotoThumbnailFragment' that displays a grid of photo thumbnails downloaded from Picasa, manages data loading via CursorLoader, handles user interactions, and customizes view binding for image display.

classes.name: PhotoThumbnailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a grid of photo thumbnails, manages data loading, user interactions, and view binding.

classes.name: GridViewAdapter
classes.description: Custom CursorAdapter for binding image data from Cursor to grid item views, inflating layout and setting images.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns a CursorLoader for querying photo URLs from the content provider.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes GridView and adapter, sets display parameters, and starts data loading.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references to avoid memory leaks.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Destroys loader and clears adapter to prevent leaks.

methods.name: onHiddenChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes of the fragment.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles thumbnail clicks, retrieves full image URL, and broadcasts intent to display full image.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates adapter with new cursor data after load completes.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears adapter data when loader is reset.

methods.name: setLoaded
methods.description: Sets internal flag indicating data load completion.
